verdict.rationale: Data portability applies to a SaaS identity-verification service, but the evidence documents no bulk export of verification data in open formats and no offboarding path. Dashboard viewing, webhooks and the 'migrate in weeks' line (which is about migrating onto Plaid, not off it) are adjacent features, not export.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
